items.title: Corporate Scaling
items.detail: Lisbon court shifts from opportunistic raids to chartered syndicate logistics.

items.title: 1444 · Companhia de Lagos
items.detail: Algarve merchants form a joint-stock slave-raiding syndicate under Prince Henry.

items.title: Arguin Bay Expedition
items.detail: Lançarote de Freitas commands six caravels, seizing 235 men, women, and children.

items.title: Aug 8, 1444 · Lagos Landing
items.detail: Six caravels disembark 235 kidnapped captives at the Lagos field.

items.title: Five-Lot Family Separation
items.detail: Captives divided into five lots on the beach, severing parents, children, and spouses.

items.title: Royal Quinto & Knighthood
items.detail: Prince Henry collects his one-fifth sovereign share on horseback and knights Lançarote.
